title: Kolosal AutoML
description: A single-crate Rust AutoML framework covering data prep, model search, trust/quality tooling, and serving in one binary.

preprocessing-scaling.title: Preprocessing & Scaling
preprocessing-scaling.description: Standard/MinMax/Robust scalers, OneHot/Label/Target/Hash encoders, and Log/Power/Box-Cox/Yeo-Johnson transformers.

missing-value-imputation.title: Missing Value Imputation
missing-value-imputation.description: Mean/median/mode/forward-fill wired into the main pipeline; standalone MICE, KNN, and iterative (linear/ridge/tree) imputers are implemented but not yet connected to the AutoML pipeline.

feature-engineering.title: Feature Engineering
feature-engineering.description: Generates polynomial features, pairwise interactions, and TF-IDF vectors to expand the feature space automatically; not yet wired into the automated pipeline.

synthetic-data-balancing.title: Synthetic Data Balancing
synthetic-data-balancing.description: SMOTE (regular + Borderline1/2), ADASYN, random over/undersampling, and NearMiss undersampling (v1/v2; v3 currently behaves like v1).

time-series-utilities.title: Time Series Utilities
time-series-utilities.description: Lag/rolling/EWM feature extraction, differencing and additive/multiplicative seasonal decomposition, and time-aware CV (expanding/sliding walk-forward, blocked, and purged+embargo splitting).

multi-model-training-engine.title: Multi-Model Training Engine
multi-model-training-engine.description: Trains 20+ algorithms (linear/logistic regression, decision trees, random forest, SVM, XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost, etc.) behind one unified interface, with a separate k-fold/stratified/time-series cross-validation toolkit.

hyperoptx-hyperparameter-search.title: HyperOptX Hyperparameter Search
hyperoptx-hyperparameter-search.description: Bayesian (Gaussian-process) and TPE samplers with median/percentile/Hyperband pruners; grid search is not yet implemented (falls back to random/TPE).

autopipeline-construction.title: AutoPipeline Construction
autopipeline-construction.description: Auto-detects numeric/categorical columns from array data and composes a preprocessing plan (impute/scale/outlier/transform); categorical encoding, feature selection, and model training are planned but not yet wired up.

ensemble-methods.title: Ensemble Methods
ensemble-methods.description: Voting ensembles (hard/soft, weighted) are implemented and tested. Stacking and blending meta-learners exist with correct out-of-fold logic but lack functional test coverage, and aren't yet wired into the main training engine (which currently treats 'stacking' as plain averaging).

neural-architecture-search.title: Neural Architecture Search
neural-architecture-search.description: REINFORCE controller and a DARTS-inspired hill-climbing architecture search, hand-implemented over ndarray with no autodiff crate and real (if crude) proxy evaluation; TabNet and FT-Transformer are currently stub architectures (no training, and FT-Transformer's predict always returns 0) not yet wired to the real GLU/sparsemax/attention layers implemented alongside them.

explainability.title: Explainability
explainability.description: Permutation importance, partial dependence (1D/2D/ICE), and a kernel-SHAP-like local explainer for per-prediction attributions.

probability-calibration.title: Probability Calibration
probability-calibration.description: Platt scaling, isotonic regression, and temperature scaling (with ECE/MCE/Brier-score reporting); beta calibration is implemented but not yet exposed in the public API.

drift-detection.title: Drift Detection
drift-detection.description: KS-test/PSI/Jensen-Shannon distributional checks plus online detectors (DDM, ADWIN, Page-Hinkley, EDDM).

anomaly-detection.title: Anomaly Detection
anomaly-detection.description: Isolation Forest and a KD-tree-backed Local Outlier Factor detect outliers via random-split isolation trees and local density ratios respectively.

pipeline-quality-gates.title: Pipeline Quality Gates
pipeline-quality-gates.description: A four-gate quality pipeline (pre-training, training, hyperopt convergence, post-training calibration/OOD) with a passing dedicated integration test suite; pre-training and post-training gates run on real data in production, while the training and hyperopt gates are currently wired with placeholder inputs rather than live CV/ensemble/hyperopt results.

web-dashboard-cli.title: Web Dashboard & CLI
web-dashboard-cli.description: An Axum-served htmx+Alpine dashboard (upload, configure, train, monitor) and a CLI (train/predict/preprocess/benchmark/serve) share one binary; e2e coverage exists for visualization and training APIs but not the full dashboard workflow.

inference-model-export.title: Inference & Model Export
inference-model-export.description: A batching/caching inference engine (real, tested) alongside ONNX/PMML export and model-registry code that exists as a standalone, well-tested library module but isn't wired into the server's export endpoint, which currently writes generic metadata rather than real ONNX/PMML files.

security-access-control.title: Security & Access Control
security-access-control.description: API key/JWT auth, sliding-window rate limiting, RBAC roles, and input-validation middleware.

iso-compliance-suite.title: ISO Compliance Suite
iso-compliance-suite.description: Fairness/bias scanning, PII detection, and data-lineage/provenance tracking are fully implemented; ISO 42001/27701/TR 24027 compliance reporting exists with standard-specific control mappings but is currently a self-reported checklist — the live API only derives a few capability flags from real system state and hardcodes the rest as compliant.
